ideas.name: no red-folder release in the last 30 minutes
ideas.why: after CPI / NFP / FOMC the first moves are repricing whipsaws, not trends

ideas.name: not a red-folder release day
ideas.why: release days are driven by one number; breakouts before it are positioning that gets unwound

ideas.name: not a Monday
ideas.why: Mondays open on the weekend's news and drift; breakouts lack follow-through

ideas.name: not a Friday
ideas.why: Friday afternoons are squared for the weekend; breakouts are unwound

ideas.name: not an options-expiry Friday
ideas.why: expiry pins price near big strikes; breakouts fail

ideas.name: not the last two sessions of the month
ideas.why: month-end rebalancing flows run against the month's trend and whipsaw intraday

ideas.name: not the session before mega-cap earnings
ideas.why: before a big report traders wait and dealers pin the index; breakouts fail

ideas.name: a mega-cap earnings session
ideas.why: a big report moves the index on news; breakouts that day are information, and they run
